newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar closes higher, below resistance.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar closes higher, below resistance.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled firmer and near the day's highs on follow-through short-covering by the funds, but the spot March contract fell shy of its resistance target, dealers said.
Still, they viewed the close a positive one and said additional short-covering Friday could lift March over key 10.70 cents.
Resistance above that level is seen at 11.00 cents.
Open interest in the March contract remains high with nearly three weeks until its expiry. Open interest stood at 59,510 lots on Wednesday's close.
Producer selling is expected to match buying point-for-point, traders said.
The spot month closed at 10.66 cent, up 0.08, having traded from 10.68 to 10.54 cents. The back months settled 0.07 to 0.04 cent firmer.
The March/May spread strengthened to 0.07 compared with 0.06 cent on Wednesday's close.
In fundamental news, the European Commission raised its 1996/97 beet sugar production estimate to 16.3 million tonnes, from 15.9 million tonnes.
